digest.component_or_area: plan-review batch runner pass-1 usage instrumentation
propositions: Pass-1 pass functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) return findings lists only, discarding per-call _usage attached by runner, and BatchRunResult.outputs carries no usage key blocking token reporting.
Per-criterion request and call counts extracted by runner._extract_usage are never persisted, blocking data-driven criterion demotion decisions.
Multi-criterion calls and ladder retries require consistent call-record aggregation with usage threaded through the entire chain: sizing→_chunk→pass functions→container fan-out→prerequisites.
Checkpoint-resumed chunks must contribute no call record and zero usage; attempted calls that raise must not contribute usage (unrecoverable from runner API).

The sidecar payload must carry coverage.usage.per_call (raw call records with criteria lists) and coverage.usage.per_criterion (per-criterion map) under exactly those keys, with multi-criterion chunks splitting token fields equally and llm_calls counting in full per criterion.
All external callers (eval_solver.py, criterion_preview.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py) must be updated atomically to unpack new (findings, usage) return pairs without breaking existing behavior.
